input.name: pixel_values
input.resize: Preserve aspect; bicubic; short side 280, cap long side at 560, round to multiples of 14. Multiples of 28 avoid 2px output rounding.

outputs.name: predicted_depth
outputs.meaning: Canonical-camera predicted depth. Focal correction required before interpreting metric distance; unused by normal-only route.

outputs.name: predicted_normal
outputs.meaning: Camera-coordinate surface normal direction. Renormalize before dot products.

outputs.name: normal_confidence
outputs.meaning: Concentration-like positive normal-confidence output; values are not probabilities and can exceed 1.

modifications: Selected FP16 ONNX artifact is unchanged from publisher. Transport chunking does not modify model bytes.

licenses.scope: Upstream Metric3D repository code; retained as attribution and provenance
licenses.copyright: Copyright (c) 2024, Wei Yin and Mu Hu

limitations: Learned surface normals and image seams are approximate. Ranges are heuristic, not calibrated confidence intervals. A still photo cannot establish precise physical wall angles.
